segment_summary: তার ঐতিহ্যবাহী জীবনধারা এবং উদারতা তার সবচেয়ে বড় সম্পদ, যা বাজারের দাপটকে অতিক্রম করে যায়।

segment_enrichment.angle: Shifting the focus from 'what does the river owe' to 'what is owed back to the source/origin of life itself.'
segment_enrichment.story_option: Setting: At the precise moment the last sliver of daylight vanishes below the horizon line. Desire: To whisper a direct question into the cooling river current itself. Obstacle: The coldness of the water acts as an immediate censor.
segment_enrichment.subject_rotation: Focusing on how the *memory* of free service becomes more valuable than the service itself.
segment_enrichment.sensory_detail: The muted visual texture of distant reeds silhouetted against a rapidly darkening sky.
segment_enrichment.research_question: Are there regional idioms that describe 'sustained, weary endurance' rather than outright struggle?
segment_enrichment.structural_variant: A poem structured as a series of rhetorical questions addressed outwards (to the river/wall) before settling on one final, unanswerable statement.
segment_enrichment.variety_note: Unlike previous chapters that focused on external pressures (bridges, debt), this chapter centers entirely on internal philosophical synthesis—the integration of accepted reality into a lasting personal conviction.
